events.summary: The Magic Origins storyline is announced: five Planeswalkers' emotional awakenings, which ignited their sparks, across ten planes.
events.quote: Each of these characters experienced an emotional awakening powerful enough to ignite their spark and change their lives forever.

events.summary: The five origin stories are scheduled in order: Chandra, Liliana, Jace, Gideon, Nissa.
events.quote: Over the next five weeks, you'll be able to read all five origin stories in this column.
